name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring 28-30 plot land scaling frozen at Day 16, a strict 9-hand workforce cap to preserve market engine orders, a 2-cycle Carrot liquidity bootstrap, protected Strawberry compounding with 3-4 flexible town shop arbitrage plots, dynamic expansion-gated liquidation floors, and late-game rapid Carrot cash-outs on barren acreage.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, contiguous layout metrics, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks after hour 18 and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation with true livestock-scaled feed reserves (n_animals * 3) to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Dedicates 3-4 flexible plot slots to fulfill high-multiplier contracts (>= 2.2x base price, including Potato and Tomato) if day + crop_growth_days <= 27, while preserving the remaining >= 85% acreage for hyper-fertilized Strawberries.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus at dynamic price floors (>= 0.84x base normal; >= 0.78x midday hours 10-16 on expansion days <= 16 or when shed fullness >= 50%), preserving a 4-6 item buffer to capture 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop premiums.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when glut risk is acute (risk >= 0.52, price >= 0.82x base) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into synchronized workforce and land scaling (8-10 plots by Day 4 with 3-4 hands; 16-18 plots by Day 8 with 6-7 hands; 28-30 contiguous plots by Day 16 with a strict 9-hand cap to preserve 1 engine order for market actions; hard land freeze at Day 16). Decouples daytime reinvestment (1.0x payroll). Bootstraps Days 1-4 with a 2-cycle Carrot liquidity engine to accumulate $1,500+ working capital, then phases in hyper-fertilized Strawberries in rolling waves across Days 5-10. Enforces a Strawberry seed cutoff at Day 22, transitioning to rapid Carrot cash-outs on barren plots through Day 26.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict micro-dispatch sequencing, crucially retaining in-situ harvest-and-water for recurring crops to prevent regrowth freezing. Prioritizes soil preparation, pre-seed hyper-fertilization, cluster harvesting up to >= 80% backpack capacity, cluster watering, shed drop-off, livestock feeding, and planting.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of unreserved, non-shop surplus inventory starting at hour 20 to guarantee payroll before midnight.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never hoard phantom wheat when n_animals == 0; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery; do not trigger emergency liquidation before hour 18 during normal daytime production.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 50.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 27)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Dedicate 3-4 flexible plot slots exclusively to fulfill active, high-multiplier town shop contracts (>= 2.2x base price, including Potato and Tomato) whenever day + crop_growth_days <= 27. Fulfill orders immediately from existing shed inventory. Preserve >= 85% of acreage for hyper-fertilized Strawberries. Hard seed procurement cutoff at Day 27.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dedicate more than 4 plots to non-Strawberry shop contracts, as it cannibalizes high-yielding Strawberry flushes. Never buy shop seeds if net available cash is below 1.25x midnight payroll. Do not hoard uncontracted surplus speculatively.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings at dynamic price floors: maintain >= 0.84x base price during standard operations. Permit sales down to 0.78x base price during midday reinvestment windows (hours 10-16) strictly on expansion days <= 16 to unlock fluid capital, or when shed fullness exceeds 50%. Preserve a 4-6 item buffer of mixed crops to opportunistically capture 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop premiums. Defend a strict minimum liquidation floor of 0.82x base on mature compounding days (Day 17-28). Conduct terminal shed clearance strictly between steps 708-716 at a defended >= 0.74x floor.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump bulk Strawberry harvests at sub-0.82x base price after Day 16 unless shed fullness exceeds 85%. Never liquidate Wheat below dynamic feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Avoid premature terminal fire-sales before step 708.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when oracle_glut_risk >= 0.52 and current_price >= 0.82 * base_price before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not front-run on hypersensitive or weak glut signals (risk < 0.52); never dump into collapsed sub-0.82 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: ((hour < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.0 + 50.0) or (hour >= 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0)) and (hired_hands < 9 or (total_plots < 30 and day <= 16) or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce dynamically alongside contiguous land: reach 8-10 plots and 3-4 hands by Day 4, 16-18 plots and 6-7 hands by Day 8, and 28-30 contiguous plots by Day 16. Strictly cap workforce at 9 hands to guarantee 1 engine order remains for critical market liquidations. Enforce a hard land expansion freeze at Day 16. Bootstrap Days 1-4 with a 2-cycle Carrot liquidity engine to build $1,500+ capital before phasing in hyper-fertilized Strawberries on Days 5-10. Terminate Strawberry procurement on Day 22, but deploy continuous rapid Carrot plantings on barren open plots through Day 26.
attributes.pitfalls: Never exceed 9 hired hands, as 10+ hands consume the entire 10-order engine cap and block market liquidations. Never purchase plots after Day 16. Never expand land when cash is below daytime reserve. Never purchase Strawberry seeds after Day 22.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands following strict micro-dispatch priority: 1) In-situ Harvest & Immediate Water recurring crops (workers harvesting ripe Strawberry plots MUST immediately water the plot in-situ if carrying water and plot is dry before departing to prevent regrowth freezing), 2) Soil Preparation & Pre-Seed Hyper-Fertilization, 3) Cluster Harvest adjacent ripe plots up to >= 80% backpack capacity, 4) Cluster Watering of any remaining dry cultivated plots, 5) Shed Drop-off (when backpack >= 80% full or hour >= 20; guarantee all carried goods deposited by step 716), 6) Livestock Feeding, 7) Planting seeds (hyper-fertilized Strawberries primary; 3-4 flexible plots for active shops; rapid Carrots on barren plots Days 23-26), 8) Till/Weed new plots.
attributes.pitfalls: NEVER decouple in-situ watering from harvesting for recurring crops; dry intervals freeze regrowth clocks and destroy Strawberry yields. Never plant Strawberry seeds on unfertilized plots. Do not drop off at shed with mostly empty backpacks unless hour >= 20. Ensure no hand idles while harvestable crops or dry plots exist.
